9.name: Hoarfrost
9.why: Fine frost laid over still air, the palest thing in the room and never cloying.

9.name: First Snowfall
9.why: The first snow settles on the glass and hushes everything beneath it.

9.name: Gergeti Snow
9.why: Morning light off the glacier above Gergeti, exact and cool and quietly dazzling.

10.name: Frozen Lake
10.why: A lake gone still under ice at dusk, clear and cold with nothing warm left in it.

10.name: Winter Dusk
10.why: The hour when the snow dims to a soft hush and the last light leaves the ridge.

10.name: Ice Palace
10.why: My own hall seen from outside at dusk, glittering and cold and perfectly still.
